shows.title: Stand Up NY Presents: Friday House Show
shows.description: Welcome to Stand Up NY at Bond 45 in Times Square! We are located on the lower level of 221 W 46th St. Reserve your seat now to enjoy some of New York’s best comedy with an incredible lineup of the most talented comedians of today — don’t miss out!The show kicks off at 9:00 pm, with doors opening at 8:30 pm. Enjoy Bond 45's menu offerings, including food, cocktails, and non-alcoholic beverages.Lineup:Brett Druck - Laughs, FOX, HuluNatan Badalov - NetflixChase DuRousseau - Just for Laughs Festiva

Join us every Wednesday, 5:00-6:00 PM, at the Hotel Edison's Times Square lobby for "Let’s Go Mental," a free standup comedy open mic supporting the 988 Lifeline, co-sponsored by GuberJokes.com and Stand Up NY. All performance fees are covered by GuberJokes.com, a Smile Message Service that supports mental health and emerging comics. Please come sign in by 4:55 PM a
